title: Tim Cook's ‘not even a quarter baked' justification for Apple's $100 billion stock buybacks has baffled some economists (AAPL)
text: Tim Cook’s ‘not even a quarter baked’ justification for Apple’s $100 billion stock buybacks has baffled some economists (AAPL) By Kif Leswing May 17, 2018, 5:34 pm 15 pts Apple CEO Tim Cook recently offered a novel argument to justify the company's use of share buybacks. Cook said that Apple's $100 million in planned buybacks will boost the economy because of the capital gains taxes investors pay when they sell their stock. Economists that Business Insider spoke to…
